name: May We Be Reunited: a Knight of Xoroth in Demon's Blood gets the Arvis Addle credit (#12443)
contract: #12443 (class 17, level 37) heard the reunion talk after turning in 'Addle's Stead' 254089 but never got the 254905 credit of 254091 'May We Be Reunited'. Julie Addle's talk and the caged Nightbane Worgen's gossip cast 'Arvis Reunion Credit' 355229, whose TargetCreatureType mask 211 (beast, dragonkin, giant, humanoid, critter) skips demons, and Unit::GetCreatureType makes a class-17 player with Demon's Blood 804345 a demon (creature type 3). rev_20261117_12443 gives the same credit through SmartAI: Julie's talk credits every player within 30 yards, and the worgen's gossip credits a speaker on 254091. Expected: a demon-typed hero who takes 254091 right after the turn-in gets the credit when the talk ends (about 51 s), and a second demon-typed player who takes 254091 afterwards gets it by talking to the worgen.
